item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: We are creating a new display in the front display case for the festival of the day of the dead. You are invited to bring to Mr. Vonesch a picture of a loved one who has died which will be displayed along with flowers and traditional Mexican decorations for this popular and culturally significant day. Please submit pictures to Mr. Vonesch by next Wednesday, October 28.

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Remembrance Day ceremonies are fast approaching. If you are a cadet, and would like to participate in the flag party, please come to the chaplaincy office to sign up.

item.title: A message from Mrs. Longval:
item.description: Attention students in Grades 9–12! Are you interested in fitness, strength training, running, or just looking for a new challenge? Mrs. Longval is putting together a **HYROX Fitness Team** to compete at North Dundas on Monday, November 30th! Students can compete individually or in teams of two, and all interested students are welcome! An information meeting will take place on Tuesday, October 27th at 11:00 AM in the weight room. Sign-up sheets are posted on the bulletin board outside the gym foyer, near the vending machine. Don't have a partner? No problem! We can help you find one! Come out, challenge yourself, and represent the Ravens!

item.title: A message from Ms. Bradley.
item.description: Today is the last day for students in grades 9 - 12 to sign-up for the University of Waterloo Canadian Intermediate and Senior Math contests. If you are still interested, drop by room #207 at lunch or send Ms. Bradley a message in TEAMS by noon today.
